analysis.headline: Shares Your Data with Meta
analysis.quote: As part of the Meta Companies , WhatsApp receives information from, and shares information (see here ) with, the other Meta Companies .

analysis.headline: Shares with Third-Party Partners
analysis.quote: We work with third-party service providers and other Meta Companies to help us operate, provide, improve, understand, customize, support, and market our Services.

analysis.headline: Retains Your Undelivered Messages
analysis.quote: If a message cannot be delivered immediately (for example, if the recipient is offline), we keep it in encrypted form on our servers for up to 30 days as we try to deliver it.

analysis.headline: Collects Your General Location
analysis.quote: Even if you do not use our location-related features, we use IP addresses and other information like phone number area codes to estimate your general location (e.g., city and country).

analysis.headline: Others Can Record Your Calls
analysis.quote: You should keep in mind that in general any user can capture screenshots of your chats or messages or make recordings of your calls with them and send them to WhatsApp or anyone else, or post them on another platform.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Detailed Usage
analysis.quote: This includes information about your activity (including how you use our Services, your Services settings, how you interact with others using our Services (including when you interact with a business), and the time, frequency, and duration of your activities and interactions), log files, and diagnostic, crash, website, and performance logs and reports.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored Globally
analysis.quote: Your information may, for example, be transferred or transmitted to, or stored and processed in, the United States; countries or territories where the Meta Companies’ affiliates and partners, or our service providers are located; or any other country or territory globally where our Services are provided outside of where you live for the purposes as described in this Privacy Policy.

analysis.headline: Business Sees Your Messages
analysis.quote: When you message with a business on WhatsApp, keep in mind that the content you share may be visible to several people in that business.

analysis.headline: Account Deletion Not Fully Private
analysis.quote: Please remember that when you delete your account, it does not affect your information related to the groups you created or the information other users have relating to you, such as their copy of the messages you sent them.
